en.headline: Consumer Council finds some supermarket multi-buy deals offer little or no saving
en.dek: A survey of 222 products at AEON, ParknShop and Wellcome showed that single-item prices during some ‘buy one get one free’ promotions were higher than in non-promotional periods.
body: The Consumer Council on Monday said some supermarket multi-buy promotions delivered smaller discounts than shoppers might expect, and in a few cases no real saving at all.

Researchers examined online prices for 222 popular packaged foods and household items sold by AEON, ParknShop and Wellcome between September 2025 and July 2026. For certain products, the single-unit price rose during the promotional window, so the effective discount after a ‘buy one get one free’ or similar offer was well below 50 per cent.

In one example involving a 150 ml bottle of sesame oil, the average unit price under a multi-buy deal was higher than the lowest non-promotional price recorded earlier. The council advised consumers to compare unit prices rather than rely on promotional labels, and suggested retailers display unit prices more clearly.

zh.headline: 消委會：超市買一送一未必抵 部分實際無折扣
zh.dek: 調查AEON、百佳及惠康222件貨品，發現部分多買優惠期間單件售價高於非促銷時段，實際折扣遠低於五折。
body: 消費者委員會周一公布，連鎖超市的「買一送一」等促銷優惠，實際折扣未必如消費者預期，個別貨品甚至可能完全無節省。
消委會分析三間超市去年9月至今年7月的網購價格，選取222件高瀏覽量包裝食品及日用品。發現部分貨品在優惠期間的單件標價明顯高於非促銷時段，折算後折扣幅度可低至約一成多。
以一款150毫升麻油為例，優惠期間平均單件售價高於較早前的最低非促銷價。消委會建議市民比較單位價格，並促請超市提升價格透明度。
